dedupe_keys.name: nasa trajectory based route analysis and control trac airspace design traffic scenario generation and runway to runway agent based air traffic simulation

description: TRAC is a NASA Ames software platform for next-generation air traffic concept research, listed in the NASA Software Catalog (case ARC-16433-1). Contents: a common representation of airspace elements (routes, fixes, sectors, airports and runways) with visualisation of current-day airspace, graphical creation and modification of new elements and format conversions, automated support for metroplex airspace design, traffic scenario generation, and runway-to-runway agent-based simulation and analysis of simulated or recorded traffic. Producer: NASA Ames; the catalogue lists build 458 from November 2019 for Windows, Linux and macOS. Coverage: generic, applied to US airspace. Format and access: released as a U.S. and Foreign Release under a NASA software usage agreement, requested through the catalogue; no public download. Licence: NASA software usage agreement. Caveats: needs airspace and traffic data supplied by the user, and access depends on NASA approval of the request. Simulation uses: designing and testing route structures and terminal airspace, capacity and conflict analysis, and disruption scenarios for airports and sectors. Related records: NASA ACES (model-nasa-aces-airspace-concepts-evaluation-system) simulates the whole National Airspace System.
